dialogue.text: Thank you, Adrian. I will handle the instruction through our processing procedures. You can review the transaction documentation when it becomes available. Please contact me if you need help locating it.

dialogue.speaker: CLIENT
dialogue.text: I'll look out for the paperwork myself. My staff handle the work calendar, but banking correspondence I keep separate. Otherwise everything ends up mixed with project emails, then very troublesome to find.

dialogue.speaker: EMPLOYEE
